facts: Parties: Brightwater Holdings Ltd (Buyer), Glenrock Capital LLP (Seller); the Company is Foxley Holdings Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 21 January 2027; Closing is scheduled for 14 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 5 years after Closing.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $2,000,000.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Foxley Pharma plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $1,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $113,180,000.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $6,100,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,800,000.
